name: io.github.claudezss/airlox
title: Airlox
description: Run your coding agent's commands on machines you own: a sandboxed job slot, not an SSH login.

packageArguments.name: --allow-dir
packageArguments.description: A directory the tools may send files from and save received files to.

environmentVariables.name: AIRLOX_OWNER_INVITE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where to save the owner link of each session the agent creates, for you to open. The tools cannot read it.

environmentVariables.name: AIRLOX_RELAY
environmentVariables.description: The relay for new sessions (for a self-hosted relay).
